Builds the origin of a component, how it entered circulation (deinstallation, demolition, offcut, surplus or unknown), as JSON for IdentityMetadata. Dates: 2024, 2024-05, 2024-05-03 or 2024-05-03T14:30:00Z; the precision follows the text. Planned marks a piece that is still in place (not yet deinstalled), At is then the planned date or empty.
